source: aoestats.io + live replay crawl (REPLAY-SOURCED match_player_units only) — PostgreSQL pipeline via the dbt winner_comps view. Military units trained (whole-match totals, not age-scoped) by WINNERS of ranked 1v1 RM, per civ x elo bucket: pct = share of winners who produced the unit, med = median trained count among those producers.
